name: Hanimi Hifumi
source: Hifumi is a genius, but acts like an idiot. He always comes up with the stupid ideas and dresses up in a silly costumes. In addition, this pervert dreams of being surrounded by girls which will call him Onii-chan. Considering that the Kimikage Academy was built at the expense of Hanimi parents, he can get away with anything.
